summary: Ohm's law, power, AC waves, frequency error, time constants, impedance and power supplies.

blocks.title: The basics
items: Series: same current, resistances add. Parallel: same voltage, total below the smallest.
Prefixes: k 1000, M 1,000,000; m thousandths, µ millionths, p millionths of µ.

items.name: E volts, I amps, R ohms
items.formula: I = E÷R, E = I×R, R = E÷I
items.means: I = R÷E is upside down, and incorrect.

items.name: Power, watts
items.means: Halve R at constant voltage: power doubles. Limits: E = √(P×R), I = √(P÷R).

blocks.title: Frequency
items: Harmonics: whole-number multiples. 2×380 kHz = 760 kHz. 2×4146 kHz = 8292 kHz.
Counter error: MHz × ppm (parts per million) = Hz. 462.1 MHz: ±1.0, 462.1 Hz; ±0.1, 46.21 Hz. 156.52 MHz: ±1.0, 156.52 Hz; ±10, 1565.20 Hz.

items.name: RMS
items.example: 340 V peak-to-peak: 170 V peak, ≈ 120 V RMS

items.name: 1 time constant: charge to 63.2%
items.formula: RC: τ = R×C. RL: τ = L÷R
items.means: MΩ×µF = seconds. Matched pairs, all series or all parallel: same τ.

blocks.title: Exam traps
items: 36.8% is what's left discharging, not the charge reached.
RL: the current reaches 63.2% of maximum, not the voltage.
50 to 1 is the impedance ratio, not turns.
